abstract: This paper focuses on a series of increases in the mortgage rate in China and investigates its impacts on household consumption. Based on granular diary data, our difference‐in‐differences estimations imply that compared with that of homeowners without mortgage obligations, the average propensity of mortgagors to consume decreases by 2.2 and 2.9 percentage points after the announcement and reset of mortgage rates, respectively. The results are mainly driven by precautionary motives associated with unanticipated shocks in lending rates. Hence, the sudden adjustment of de facto policy‐controlled rates has higher welfare costs than that of market‐driven lending rates.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于中国一系列抵押贷款利率上调，并考察其对家庭消费的影响。基于高频日记数据，我们的双重差分估计表明，与没有抵押贷款义务的房主相比，抵押贷款借款人的平均消费倾向在抵押贷款利率公告和重定价后分别下降2.2个和2.9个百分点。这一结果主要由与贷款利率未预期冲击相关的预防性动机驱动。因此，对事实上受政策控制的利率进行突然调整，其福利成本高于对市场驱动的贷款利率进行调整。

abstract: This paper analyses the long‐term effects of preschool education in France. We focus on the effect of preschool duration on educational attainment and labour market earnings in adulthood. Building on an old tradition of free and universal pre‐primary education, France implemented in the late 1960s a large‐scale expansion of preschooling facilities, leading to a massive increase in the supply of preschool. We rely on the independent variation across counties and cohorts in preschool supply, induced by this policy, to assess the effect of preschool using a Two‐Sample Two‐Stage Least Squares estimator. While the preschool expansion increased preschool duration ( years per additional school created), we find on average small and non‐significant long‐term effects on employment and earnings, with some positive impacts on educational attainment. We also investigate heterogeneity by parental socio‐economic status and find that children from an advantaged family background benefit significantly more in terms of both education and earnings than their peers from less advantaged backgrounds. One additional year in preschool thus increases the achievement gap for most outcomes including the likelihood of graduating from high school ( percentage points) or college ( pp), employment ( pp), unemployment ( pp) and earnings ().
abstract_zh: 本文分析了法国学前教育的长期效应。我们重点关注学前受教育年限对成年后教育程度和劳动力市场收入的影响。基于免费且普及的学前教育这一悠久传统，法国于20世纪60年代末大规模扩建学前教育设施，使学前教育供给大幅增加。我们借助这一政策所导致的各县与各队列之间学前教育供给的独立变异，采用双样本两阶段最小二乘估计量评估学前教育的影响。尽管学前教育扩张增加了学前受教育年限（每新增一所学校增加若干年），但我们发现，平均而言，其对就业和收入的长期效应较小且不显著，对教育程度则有一定正向影响。我们还考察了按父母社会经济地位划分的异质性，发现来自优势家庭背景的儿童在教育和收入方面的获益均显著高于来自较弱势背景的同龄人。因此，多接受一年学前教育会扩大大多数结果上的成就差距，包括高中毕业的可能性（百分点）或大学毕业（百分点）、就业（百分点）、失业（百分点）和收入（）。

abstract: This study investigates pro‐sociality among individuals during an ongoing war. We focus on Yemen, where the recent large‐scale conflict has divided the country geographically, putting different regions in opposition with one another. We collect original survey data and develop a mobile phone‐based version of a public good game to allow participants from regions on opposite sides of the conflict to play in pairs across the entire country. Participants play two games: one with an in‐group partner (from the same region) and one with a randomly assigned partner from a different region—either from the antagonistic out‐group (opposite conflict side) or from the non‐antagonistic out‐group (same conflict side). We further merge our data with the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data Project (ACLED) conflict data to explore whether conflict intensity affects participants' behaviours in the games. Our results show a lower level of cooperation with the rival out‐group compared to the non‐rival out‐group, along with higher in‐group cooperation among participants heavily exposed to the war. Further results show that lower pro‐sociality towards the rival out‐group is mostly found among players from the North of Yemen, where sectarian identity is most clearly tied to the conflict division, and this effect is exacerbated by the intensity of conflict exposure. These results provide some of the clearest empirical support to date for concerns about the destruction of inter‐group cooperation during an ongoing war.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了战争持续期间个体的亲社会性。我们以也门为研究对象，近期的大规模冲突将该国在地理上分裂，使不同地区彼此对立。我们收集了原始调查数据，并开发了基于手机的公共品博弈版本，使来自冲突对立双方地区的参与者能够在全国范围内配对进行博弈。参与者进行两轮博弈：一轮与内群体伙伴（来自同一地区），另一轮与随机分配的来自不同地区的伙伴——或来自敌对的外群体（冲突对立一方），或来自非敌对的外群体（冲突同一方）。我们进一步将数据与武装冲突地点与事件数据项目（ACLED）的冲突数据合并，以探究冲突强度是否影响参与者在博弈中的行为。我们的结果显示，与非敌对的外群体相比，参与者对敌对的外群体表现出更低的合作水平；而在受战争影响严重的参与者中，内群体合作水平更高。进一步的结果显示，对敌对的外群体较低的亲社会性主要体现在也门北部的参与者中，在该地区，教派身份与冲突分野的联系最为明确，且这一效应因冲突暴露强度而加剧。这些结果为迄今关于持续战争期间群体间合作遭到破坏的担忧提供了最为清晰的实证支持之一。

abstract: In many countries, jobseekers who receive unemployment insurance must commit to an action plan to support their return to work and are monitored and coached to ensure compliance. In some countries means‐tested benefit claimants who are in regular but low income employment are also subject to monitoring and coaching (M&C), in order that they can progress into jobs with a higher level of income. In this paper we study the impact of M&C on in‐work claimants in the United Kingdom using a difference‐in‐differences design. Drawing on data from a randomised controlled trial of Universal Credit claimants, we find that M&C leads to increased earnings over time. The results do however show considerable heterogeneity by gender, age and across the earnings distribution.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，领取失业保险的求职者必须承诺制定一项支持其重返工作岗位的行动计划，并接受监督和辅导以确保合规。在一些国家，处于常规但低收入就业中的经济状况调查型福利申领者同样需要接受监督与辅导（M&C），以便他们能够晋升到收入水平更高的工作岗位。本文利用双重差分设计，研究M&C对英国在职申领者的影响。基于一项针对Universal Credit申领者的随机对照试验数据，我们发现M&C会随时间推移带来收入增长。然而，结果确实显示出在性别、年龄以及收入分布方面存在相当大的异质性。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: An Econometric Evaluation of the Effectiveness of In‐Work Support for Earnings Progression

abstract: The COVID‐19 pandemic led to an unprecedented increase in households' savings. In this paper, we quantify excess savings and investigate their distribution across assets and households in Italy. We find these extra resources were primarily allocated to financial and real assets and distributed unevenly across households. In particular, by end‐2023, excess financial assets were about €110 billion: they were skewed towards less liquid activities amongst affluent families, whilst going into deposits amongst the less well‐off, making the latter vulnerable to erosion from escalating prices. Survey data suggest a muted role for excess resources in bolstering aggregate consumption: 3 years after the outbreak of the COVID‐19 pandemic, disadvantaged families held a modest amount of financial assets, whilst wealthier households could increase spending without dipping into their resources.
abstract_zh: 新冠疫情导致家庭储蓄空前增加。本文量化了意大利的过剩储蓄，并考察其在各类资产和家庭之间的分布。我们发现，这些额外资源主要配置于金融资产和实物资产，且在家庭之间分布不均。具体而言，截至2023年底，过剩金融资产约为1100亿欧元：在富裕家庭中，这些资产偏向流动性较低的活动，而在较不富裕家庭中则流入存款，使后者易受物价上涨的侵蚀。调查数据表明，过剩资源在支撑总消费方面的作用有限：新冠疫情暴发三年后，弱势家庭持有的金融资产规模有限，而较富裕家庭则可在不动用其资源的情况下增加支出。

abstract: This article uses matched UK administrative data to examine the impact of trade shocks on R&D investments of UK manufacturing firms from 2002 to 2011. We pay particular attention to the controversial effect of Chinese import competition on firm innovation. Our analysis provides strong evidence that the rise in imports from China, following its accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001, led to a significant decrease in R&D spending among UK firms. Importantly, we find considerable heterogeneity in this effect based on firm size: Chinese competition was particularly detrimental to the R&D of small firms, while its impact on large firms was not statistically significant. We also document the positive role of export market size in stimulating firm R&D, indicating that booming export demand during this period helped to somewhat offset the adverse effects of Chinese competition.
abstract_zh: 本文使用匹配的英国行政数据，考察2002年至2011年间贸易冲击对英国制造业企业研发投资的影响。我们尤其关注中国进口竞争对企业创新颇具争议的影响。我们的分析提供了有力证据，表明中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织后其对英出口的上升，导致英国企业研发支出显著下降。重要的是，我们发现这一效应因企业规模而存在相当大的异质性：中国竞争对小型企业的研发尤为不利，而其对大型企业的影响在统计上并不显著。我们还记录了出口市场规模对刺激企业研发的积极作用，表明这一时期出口需求的繁荣在一定程度上帮助抵消了中国竞争的不利影响。

abstract: This paper presents a state‐dependent extension of the Phillips Curve using a local projections (LPs) panel model based on data from 14 countries between January 1999 and December 2023. State dependence arises from the asymmetric effects of the El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO), which alternates between El Niño and La Niña phases. The results reveal two dimensions of this asymmetry. First, the Phillips Curve is steeper during La Niña episodes, with inflation responding more strongly to unemployment gaps. Second, we find evidence of dynamic propagation: La Niña episodes produce stronger and more persistent inflationary effects than El Niño. These findings underscore the importance of incorporating ENSO‐related asymmetries into macroeconomic models.
abstract_zh: 本文基于1999年1月至2023年12月期间14个国家的数据，采用局部投影（LPs）面板模型，提出了菲利普斯曲线的状态依赖扩展。状态依赖源于厄尔尼诺—南方涛动（ENSO）的非对称效应，该现象在厄尔尼诺与拉尼娜相位之间交替。结果揭示了这种非对称性的两个维度。第一，拉尼娜期间菲利普斯曲线更陡峭，通胀对失业缺口的反应更强。第二，我们发现了动态传导的证据：拉尼娜事件产生的通胀效应比厄尔尼诺更强且更持久。这些发现凸显了将ENSO相关非对称性纳入宏观经济模型的重要性。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: ENSO‐Augmented Phillips Curve: Evidence From Panel Local Projections
title_zh: ENSO增强的菲利普斯曲线：来自面板局部投影的证据

abstract: The standard macroeconomic literature suggests that richer countries employ more productive technologies. Removing technological disparities between countries would hence narrow the substantial variation in output per worker across countries. But technology is factor‐neutral in this standard development accounting approach, which is at odds with important macroeconomic frameworks and empirical results. We hence develop a CES production structure with factor‐biased technologies and revisit the question: how much would the variation in output per worker across countries narrow if all countries had access to the same menu of production technologies? Our results for the aggregate market sector suggest: probably not at all. But there are remarkable differences for this result across five subsectors. We use those to illustrate that our presumably surprising finding results from an interplay of complementary production factors, factor bias of technologies, and the menu of available technologies.
abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济文献表明，较富裕的国家采用生产率更高的技术。因此，消除国家间的技术差异将缩小各国单位工人产出之间的巨大差异。但在这种标准的发展核算方法中，技术是要素中性的，这与重要的宏观经济框架和实证结果不一致。因此，我们构建了一个具有要素偏向性技术的CES生产结构，并重新审视这一问题：如果所有国家都能获得相同的生产技术菜单，各国单位工人产出的差异会缩小多少？我们对总体市场部门的结果表明：可能根本不会缩小。但这一结果在五个子部门之间存在显著差异。我们利用这些差异来说明，我们这一看似令人惊讶的发现源于互补生产要素、技术的要素偏向性以及可用技术菜单之间的相互作用。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Accounting for Cross‐Country Differences in Output Per Worker: A Sectoral CES Perspective
title_zh: 解释跨国劳动生产率差异：一个部门CES视角

abstract: We examine how labour market institutions shape monetary policy transmission in euro area countries. A theoretical model suggests that higher union density flattens the Phillips curve, amplifying output responses while dampening the inflation effects of monetary shocks. This is empirically confirmed using an interacted panel VAR. In contrast, benefit replacement rates and employment protection legislation have a limited impact. Our findings point to a structural, not cyclical, driver of monetary policy effectiveness, highlighting the importance of labour market features. In a monetary union, such heterogeneity can lead to inefficient inflation and output differentials across member states.
abstract_zh: 我们考察劳动力市场制度如何塑造欧元区国家的货币政策传导。一个理论模型表明，更高的工会密度会使菲利普斯曲线更加平坦，从而放大产出对货币政策冲击的响应，同时抑制其通胀效应。本文使用交互面板VAR对此进行了实证确认。相比之下，失业救济替代率和就业保护立法的影响有限。我们的发现指向货币政策有效性的一个结构性而非周期性驱动因素，凸显了劳动力市场特征的重要性。在货币联盟中，这种异质性可能导致成员国之间出现无效率的通胀和产出差异。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: The Role of Labour Market Institutions in Shaping Euro Area Monetary Policy Transmission
title_zh: 劳动力市场制度在塑造欧元区货币政策传导中的作用

abstract: In this study, we suggest an imputation approach for estimating treatment effect parameters when untreated potential outcomes follow a panel data model that has both interactive fixed effects (IFE) and additive two‐way fixed effects. In settings with common treatment timing and staggered treatment adoption, we consider a hybrid approach involving classical and Bayesian methods. First, using the classical random sampling approach across units, we show that treatment effect parameters are identified in our setting under a selection on observables and unobservables assumption. We then suggest an efficient Gibbs sampler for estimating the treatment effect parameters using our suggested imputation approach. We consider two Bayesian methods for selecting the number of factors in the postulated model for untreated potential outcomes. We provide simulation evidence showing that our imputation approach performs satisfactorily. In an empirical application, we use our approach to study the causal effect of police presence on crime.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们提出了一种插补方法，用于在未处理潜在结果遵循同时包含交互固定效应（IFE）和可加双向固定效应的面板数据模型时估计处理效应参数。在共同处理时点和交错处理采纳的设定下，我们考虑了一种结合经典方法与贝叶斯方法的混合方法。首先，使用跨个体的经典随机抽样方法，我们证明在可观测和不可观测选择假设下，我们的设定中处理效应参数是可识别的。然后，我们提出了一种高效的Gibbs抽样器，使用我们建议的插补方法来估计处理效应参数。我们考虑了两种贝叶斯方法，用于选择未处理潜在结果假定模型中因子的数量。我们提供了模拟证据，表明我们的插补方法表现令人满意。在一项实证应用中，我们使用我们的方法研究了警察存在对犯罪的因果效应。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Bayesian Estimation of Treatment Effects in Interactive Fixed Effects Models
title_zh: 交互固定效应模型中处理效应的贝叶斯估计

abstract: This paper examines long‐run unconditional convergence of labour productivity in manufacturing across 48 contiguous U.S. states. We construct a detailed panel data set of state‐industry pairs with over 120 industries covering the period 1880–2007. The remarkable finding is a rapid rate of unconditional ‐convergence: 7.6% per year in the period 1880–2007, and about 6.5% in each period 1880–1940 and 1958–2007. We also find a steep rise in unconditional convergence from 5.5% in 1930–1940 to 10.6% in 1940–1947 and 9.4% in 1947–1958, followed by a considerable drop thereafter. In the years 1958–2007, the rate of convergence in ICT industries (8.3%) is higher than in 1st‐Industrial‐Revolution (6.3%) or 2nd‐Industrial‐Revolution (7.0%) industries. We interpret our results as a process of technological catch up between initially laggard Southern manufacturing and manufacturing industries in the North.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国本土48个州制造业劳动生产率的长期无条件收敛。我们构建了一个详细的州—产业配对面板数据集，涵盖120多个产业，时间跨度为1880—2007年。一个显著发现是快速的无条件收敛速度：1880—2007年期间为每年7.6%，而在1880—1940年和1958—2007年两个时期均约为6.5%。我们还发现，无条件收敛速度从1930—1940年的5.5%急剧上升至1940—1947年的10.6%和1947—1958年的9.4%，此后则出现显著下降。在1958—2007年间，信息通信技术产业的收敛速度（8.3%）高于第一次工业革命产业（6.3%）或第二次工业革命产业（7.0%）。我们将结果解释为最初落后的南方制造业与北方制造业之间的一种技术追赶过程。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: A Long‐Run Perspective on Unconditional Convergence in Manufacturing: Evidence From U.S. Industrialisation
title_zh: 制造业无条件收敛的长期视角：来自美国工业化的证据

abstract: We address an important research gap by quantifying the association between weather conditions (sunshine, rainfall, temperature anomalies) and individual financial, mental and physical health self‐assessments. We compile a unique dataset of observations (1991–2018) by matching individual‐level data (covering 380 Local Authorities) from the British Household Panel & UK Household Longitudinal Surveys to monthly and daily data from 32 weather stations. We provide robust evidence that favourable climatic conditions are positively related to the likelihood of reporting higher well‐being assessments, and negatively related to adverse conditions (particularly temperature anomalies). The estimated weather monetary cost reaches 15% of monthly household income.
abstract_zh: 我们通过量化天气状况（日照、降雨、温度异常）与个体财务、心理及身体健康自评之间的关联，填补了一项重要的研究空白。我们构建了一个独特的观测数据集（1991—2018年），其方法是将来自英国家庭面板调查与英国家庭纵向调查的个体层面数据（覆盖380个地方政府辖区）与来自32个气象站的月度和日度数据进行匹配。我们提供了稳健的证据，表明有利的气候条件与报告更高福祉自评的可能性呈正相关，而与不利条件（尤其是温度异常）呈负相关。估计的天气货币成本达到家庭月收入的15%。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Quantifying the Relationship Between Climatic Conditions and Personal Financial and Health Well‐Being
title_zh: 量化气候条件与个人财务及健康福祉之间的关系

abstract: We examine how households' euro‐area inflation expectations reacted to the ECB's adoption of a symmetric inflation target in July 2021, and the subsequent inflation surge. Using a randomised control trial within a monthly representative survey, we elicit short‐ and long‐term inflation expectations. We find that the ECB's strategy announcement had no material effect on expectations. In contrast, the sharp rise in actual inflation significantly raised point forecasts and expected probabilities of high inflation. These findings suggest that households' expectations became less well anchored and more sensitive to inflation realizations in the high‐inflation period, likely reflecting inter alia reduced rational inattention.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了家庭对欧元区通胀的预期如何回应欧洲央行于2021年7月采用对称通胀目标，以及随后的通胀飙升。通过在月度代表性调查中开展随机对照试验，我们引出了短期和长期通胀预期。我们发现，欧洲央行的策略公告对预期没有实质性影响。相比之下，实际通胀的急剧上升显著提高了点预测和高通胀的预期概率。这些发现表明，在高通胀时期，家庭的预期变得不那么锚定，且对通胀实现更为敏感，这可能尤其反映了理性疏忽的减少。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Reactions of Household Inflation Expectations to a Symmetric Inflation Target and High Inflation
title_zh: 家庭通胀预期对对称通胀目标和高通胀的反应

abstract: This paper examines the impact of democratisation on internal conflict, with a focus on the timing of effects and the type of conflict involved. Using a local projection‐based difference‐in‐differences approach and a panel of 160 countries from 1919 to 2021, we distinguish between minor (e.g., protests and strikes) and major (e.g., revolutions and assassinations) conflict events through factor analysis. We find that democratisation leads to a substantial and persistent decline in minor conflict, with effects growing stronger over time. For major conflict, point estimates are generally negative and become statistically significant only after more than a decade post‐democratisation. These results are consistent with the view that democratisation can defuse lower‐intensity unrest, whereas evidence on large‐scale violence suggests that it is subject to a slower adjustment process. The findings enhance our understanding of the democratisation‐conflict nexus and provide insights for policy formulation and conflict management strategies.
abstract_zh: 本文考察民主化对国内冲突的影响，重点关注效应的时间节点和所涉冲突类型。使用基于局部投影的双重差分方法以及1919年至2021年间160个国家的面板数据，我们通过因子分析区分了轻微冲突事件（如抗议和罢工）与重大冲突事件（如革命和暗杀）。我们发现，民主化会导致轻微冲突大幅且持续下降，且效应随时间推移而增强。对于重大冲突，点估计总体为负，且仅在民主化后十多年才具有统计显著性。这些结果与以下观点一致：民主化能够化解低强度动荡，而关于大规模暴力的证据则表明其调整过程较为缓慢。这些发现增进了我们对民主化—冲突关系的理解，并为政策制定和冲突管理策略提供了启示。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Breaking Bad or Making Amends? The Dynamics of Internal Conflict After Democratisation
title_zh: 打破恶性循环还是修复关系？民主化后内部冲突的动态

abstract: This paper analyzes narratively identified statutory tax reforms in the US and shows that the average impact of monetary policy on employment varies depending on the tax treatment firms receive. Specifically, monetary policy has a greater impact on employment when firms face tax increases, relative to the times when firms face stable taxes. Moreover, monetary policy is least effective on employment when firms face marginal tax cuts. The evidence is consistent with the debt tax shield channel and is most pronounced in the employment responses of firms with high leverage.
abstract_zh: 本文对美国叙事识别的法定税制改革进行分析，并表明货币政策对就业的平均影响因企业所受到的税收待遇而异。具体而言，相对于企业面临稳定税收的时期，当企业面临增税时，货币政策对就业的影响更大。此外，当企业面临边际减税时，货币政策对就业的效果最弱。这些证据与债务税盾渠道相一致，并且在高杠杆企业的就业反应中最为显著。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Corporate Taxes and Monetary Effectiveness: Evidence on Employment
title_zh: 公司税与货币有效性：来自就业的证据

abstract: This study examines the relationship between religiosity and vaccine hesitancy. I reveal a robust negative and non‐linear association between church attendance and COVID‐19 vaccination rates across Polish municipalities. Utilising survey data, I find that more religious individuals are less likely to accept the COVID19 vaccine, and their willingness decreases with higher local‐level religiosity, suggesting the presence of peer effects. I also examine how believers' lower vaccine acceptance is shaped by both direct and mediated effects in the mediation analysis.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了宗教虔诚与疫苗犹豫之间的关系。我揭示了波兰各市镇中教堂出席率与COVID-19疫苗接种率之间存在稳健的负向非线性关联。利用调查数据，我发现更为虔诚的个体更不可能接受COVID-19疫苗，且其接种意愿随地方层面宗教虔诚度的提高而下降，这表明存在同伴效应。我还在中介分析中考察了信徒较低的疫苗接受度如何同时受到直接效应和中介效应的影响。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Religiosity and Vaccine Hesitancy: Evidence From COVID‐19 Vaccination in Poland
title_zh: 宗教虔诚与疫苗犹豫：来自波兰COVID-19疫苗接种的证据

abstract: This paper presents a novel perspective on the identification at infinity as identification at the boundary, for the intercept of the sample selection model, via a transformation of the selection index. This perspective suggests generalisations of estimation at infinity to kernel regression estimation at the boundary and further to local linear estimation at the boundary. The proposed kernel‐type estimators with an estimated transformation are proven to be nonparametric‐rate consistent and asymptotically normal under mild regularity conditions. A fully data‐driven method of selecting the optimal bandwidths for the estimators is developed. The Monte Carlo simulation shows the desirable finite sample properties of the proposed estimators and bandwidth selection procedures.
abstract_zh: 本文通过选择指数的变换，为样本选择模型截距的无穷远处识别提供了一种新视角，即边界处识别。这一视角表明，可将无穷远处估计推广到边界处的核回归估计，并进一步推广到边界处的局部线性估计。在温和的正则条件下，所提出的带有估计变换的核型估计量被证明具有非参数速率相合性且渐近正态。本文还开发了一种完全数据驱动的方法来选择估计量的最优带宽。蒙特卡洛模拟显示了所提出的估计量和带宽选择程序具有良好的有限样本性质。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: On Semiparametric Estimation of the Intercept of the Sample Selection Model: A Kernel Approach
title_zh: 样本选择模型截距的半参数估计：一种核方法

abstract: Using GIS methods, we identify territories in Africa affected by subnational border reforms between 1992 and 2013. Descriptive statistics reveal that these territories differed from other African regions across several key dimensions. For example, these territories were more populous and exhibited greater ethnic diversity. We then examine the association between subnational border reforms and economic activity across 17 African countries. Grid‐level estimations indicate a positive association between border reforms and local economic activity. However, allowing for country‐level heterogeneity reveals that border reforms are negatively associated with local economic activity in six countries. Excluding Ethiopia from the sample substantially reduces the magnitude of the overall positive estimate. A systematic examination of heterogeneity reveals that border reforms implemented for administrative purposes are positively associated with economic activity, while those driven by ethnic politics have no effect.
abstract_zh: 我们运用GIS方法，识别出1992年至2013年间受撒哈拉以南非洲国家以下层级边界改革影响的地区。描述性统计显示，这些地区在若干关键维度上与其他非洲区域存在差异。例如，这些地区人口更为密集，且族群多样性程度更高。随后，我们考察了17个非洲国家中国家以下层级边界改革与经济活动的关联。网格层面的估计表明，边界改革与地方经济活动呈正相关。然而，在允许国家层面异质性后可以发现，边界改革在六个国家中与地方经济活动呈负相关。将埃塞俄比亚从样本中剔除后，总体正相关估计的幅度大幅下降。对异质性的系统性考察显示，出于行政目的实施的边界改革与经济活动呈正相关，而由族群政治驱动的边界改革则没有影响。

journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Subnational Border Reforms and Economic Activity in Africa
title_zh: 非洲次国家边界改革与经济活动

abstract: This paper proposes a novel procedure to identify latent groups in the slopes of panel data models with interactive effects. The method is straightforward to apply and relies only on closed‐form estimators when evaluating the objective function. This achieves substantial computational gains compared to alternative non‐linear methods and enables estimation even in large datasets. We establish consistency of the procedure and confirm through simulations its good finite sample properties and the validity of post‐grouping inference routines. The procedure's empirical usefulness is illustrated with applications to output growth and international trade.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，用于识别具有交互效应的面板数据模型斜率中的潜在群体。该方法应用简便，且在评估目标函数时仅依赖于闭式估计量。与替代的非线性方法相比，这实现了显著的计算优势，并使得即使在大数据集中的估计也成为可能。我们证明了该方法的一致性，并通过模拟确认了其良好的有限样本性质以及分组后推断程序的有效性。该方法的实证实用性通过应用于产出增长和国际贸易得到了展示。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Panel Sequential Group Estimation of Interactive Effects Models
title_zh: 交互效应模型的面板序贯组估计

abstract: Politicians disagree about fiscal policy. This disagreement should have economic effects beyond the effects of government spending and taxation. We use the full set of speeches in the German Bundestag since 1960 and apply state‐of‐the art natural language processing techniques to construct two series of fiscal disagreement starting in 1970: disagreement about fiscal policy between the government and the opposition and disagreement within the coalition government. Both series fluctuate strongly and peak in 1982/83, but are also notably different from each other. In a VAR analysis, we show that within‐coalition disagreement has adverse effects on real activity. Higher disagreement causes a drop in industrial production, manufacturing orders and stock prices. In contrast, government‐opposition disagreement does not affect the business cycle.
abstract_zh: 政治家们对财政政策存在分歧。这种分歧应当会产生超出政府支出和税收影响之外的经济效应。我们使用1960年以来德国联邦议院的全部演讲，并应用最先进的自然语言处理技术，构建了两个始于1970年的财政分歧序列：政府与反对派之间关于财政政策的分歧，以及联合政府内部的分歧。这两个序列均波动剧烈，并在1982/83年达到峰值，但彼此之间也存在显著差异。在一项VAR分析中，我们表明联合政府内部的分歧对实际经济活动具有不利影响。分歧加剧会导致工业生产、制造业订单和股票价格下降。相比之下，政府与反对派之间的分歧不影响经济周期。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Disagreement About Fiscal Policy
title_zh: 财政政策分歧

abstract: This paper shows that the classic augmented Mundlak regression yields the between estimator for time‐invariant variables. It is well known that the estimates of the time varying variables yield the fixed effects estimates. While the latter are consistent for this correlated random effects model, the between estimates are not. The between estimator is consistent only when the Hausman test does not reject the null based on between versus fixed effects. An alternative modified Hausman and Taylor estimator is proposed. Monte Carlo experiments are performed to compare various estimators under a correlated random effects as well as a purely random effects model.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，经典的增广Mundlak回归对时间不变变量给出了组间估计量。众所周知，对时变变量的估计会得到固定效应估计。虽然后者对这种相关随机效应模型是一致的，但组间估计并非如此。只有当基于组间与固定效应的Hausman检验不拒绝原假设时，组间估计量才是一致的。本文提出了一种替代的修正Hausman和Taylor估计量。通过蒙特卡洛实验，在相关随机效应模型以及纯随机效应模型下比较了各种估计量。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Time Invariant Variables in the Mundlak and Hausman–Taylor Panel Data Models
title_zh: Mundlak与Hausman-Taylor面板数据模型中的时不变变量

abstract: Transport electrification depends on sustained innovation in the new energy vehicle industry, yet geopolitical instability can weaken the conditions under which firms invest in and commercialize new technologies. Using a 2012-2024 panel of Chinese listed firms in the new energy vehicle value chain, this study constructs a market-implied firm-level measure of geopolitical risk exposure from rolling asset-pricing regressions and examines its relationship with technological innovation. Higher exposure is associated with lower patent output, and the relationship remains robust across alternative measures, specifications, and sample definitions. Additional analyses identify two firm responses to geopolitical stress: greater concentration of supply-chain relationships and higher precautionary cash retention. The negative association is more pronounced for firms with greater structural vulnerability and weaker financial or organizational buffers. These findings suggest that policies for transport electrification should complement demand-side support with measures that preserve innovation finance, diversify access to critical inputs, and strengthen supply-chain resilience under external shocks.

journal: Energy Policy
title: Geopolitical risk exposure and innovation in the new energy vehicle industry: Policy implications for transport electrification
title_zh: 地缘政治风险暴露与新能源汽车产业创新：对交通电动化的政策启示

abstract: This paper examines the effects of intelligent manufacturing on firm markups by exploiting the staggered rollout of industrial robot parks in China as a quasi-natural experiment. Using comprehensive tax survey data from 2010 to 2020, we find that exposure to industrial robot park policies significantly increases firm markups. Mechanism analyses suggest that intelligent manufacturing operates through two channels: it enhances internal allocative efficiency by raising the marginal productivity of capital and labor, while simultaneously optimizing cost structures by reducing several observable production and operating cost ratios. Supplementary evidence from exporting firms provides additional, though suggestive, support for the cost-side channel. Heterogeneity analyses indicate that the effects are stronger among private and larger firms and in technology-intensive, heavy, and more concentrated industries. Geographically, however, the policy fosters regional convergence by disproportionately benefiting lagging inland regions. Finally, we find significant positive spatial spillovers, with markup gains extending to neighboring counties. These findings highlight industrial robot parks as place-based policy instruments that shape how intelligent manufacturing affects the structural determinants of market power.

title: How intelligent manufacturing shapes markups: A quasi-natural experiment in China
title_zh: 智能制造如何塑造加成率：来自中国的准自然实验

abstract: We examine how managers perceive climate risk and shift their attention, thereby influencing corporate environmental responsibility (CER). Using annual reports, we construct the climate risk perceived by 2650 Chinese listed companies from 2010 to 2020. We find that CER first increases and then decreases after a turning point in climate risk perception (CRP), represented by an inverted U-shaped association. This curvilinear association is mainly driven by climate transition risk perception. In contrast, we do not find a consistent or robust association between climate physical risk perception and CER. Furthermore, positive performance feedback is found to weaken the inverted U-shaped association between CRP and CER. Further analysis shows the impact of CRP on the components of CER and the heterogenous effect under different institutional pressures. The results have important implications for managing climate risk by companies and government.
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为2650家中国上市公司2010-2020年数据，核心应用与制度背景均在中国。
journal: Energy Economics
title: Climate risk perception, performance feedback and corporate environmental responsibility
title_zh: 气候风险感知、绩效反馈与企业环境责任

abstract: This study investigates how kinship intensity within family business boards influences firms’ ability to balance exploratory and exploitative innovation. Using a sample of around 7989 firm-year observations of Chinese A-share listed family businesses over the period 2012–2020, we show that stronger kinship ties among board members increase exploratory innovation but reduce exploitative innovation. We argue that closely related board members reinforce long-term socioemotional preferences and enhance goal alignment, which encourages resource allocation toward exploration, while simultaneously elevating hierarchical control and resource concentration that crowd out incremental refinement activities. Further analyses reveal that these associations are primarily driven by core family members (e.g., spouses, parents, and children), whereas kinship intensity among non-core family members has weaker or no influence. These findings highlight that heterogeneity in family relationships, rather than family presence alone, is central to explaining innovation ambidexterity in family businesses.

journal: Economic Modelling
title: Kinship intensity and innovation ambidexterity in family businesses: Venturing into the unknown
title_zh: 家族企业中的亲属关系强度与创新双元性：探索未知领域

abstract: Using a global dyadic panel from 1950 to 2021, we find a positive association between arms transfers from an exporter to an importer and general goods exports to that partner. The effects are short‐run: export responses peak around the transfer and fade within a few years. The arms‐trade linkage is smaller among highly institutionalized, high‐income partnerships and larger where security and commerce are more tightly bundled, especially in dyads linked by overseas military presence. Consistent with a political‐alignment channel, arms transfers are followed by lower United Nations voting disagreement. The associated trade increase does not reflect a symmetric improvement in relations.
abstract_zh: 利用1950年至2021年的全球双边面板数据，我们发现，出口国向进口国转让武器与该伙伴国的一般商品出口之间存在正相关关系。这种效应是短期的：出口反应在转让前后达到峰值，并在几年内逐渐消退。在高度制度化、高收入伙伴关系中，武器贸易关联度较小；而在安全与商业联系更为紧密的情况下，尤其是在存在海外军事存在的双边关系中，这种关联度则更大。与政治结盟渠道一致，武器转让后联合国投票分歧有所减少。相关的贸易增长并不反映双边关系的对称性改善。
china_relevance_reason: 研究基于1950-2021年全球双边面板数据，分析军火转让对贸易的影响，未聚焦中国、中国企业或中国制度背景，作者姓名不构成判定依据。
journal: Economic Inquiry
title: Guns for butter: Trade effects of arms transfers
title_zh: 枪支换黄油：武器转让的贸易效应

abstract: This article posits the contradictory relation between capitalist and non-capitalist segments of an economy as a key dimension of the colonial encounter and as a critical and constitutive element in the contemporary process of postcolonial capitalist development. It points to the obfuscation of this contradiction in the prevalent theoretical approaches in development economics, particularly focusing on the discourse on informal economy and the role of identity. It then foregrounds an emerging theoretical framework on postcolonial economic dynamics — and its key methodological tenets — that frames the development process as being marked by this on-going and ever-occurring contradiction. The article, however, highlights a key gap in this framework to grapple with the role of identities in these development dynamics, and points to some critical methodological approaches to identity that may be productively integrated to further develop it. Finally, the article provides empirical illustrations from the Indian context that underscores the constitutive role of caste in shaping both the reproduction of non-capitalist informal enterprises that sustain the working populations excluded from the capitalist segments, as well as the selective inclusion of parts of this population into capitalist segments as informal wage labor — processes that can be generatively interpreted through the above theoretical framework. Through this intervention, the article aims to clear grounds towards formulating a pathway to build a decolonized approach to contemporary processes of economic development.
abstract_zh: 本文提出，经济中资本主义与非资本主义部分之间的矛盾关系，是殖民遭遇的一个关键维度，也是当代后殖民资本主义发展进程中一个批判性和构成性的要素。文章指出，发展经济学中流行的理论方法对此矛盾的模糊处理，尤其聚焦于非正式经济话语及身份角色的讨论。随后，文章凸显了一个关于后殖民经济动态的新兴理论框架及其关键方法论原则，该框架将发展过程视为被这一持续且不断发生的矛盾所标记。然而，文章也指出了该框架在处理身份在这些发展动态中作用方面的一个关键空白，并提出了一些关于身份的关键方法论途径，这些途径可能被富有成效地整合以进一步发展该框架。最后，文章提供了来自印度背景的实证例证，强调了种姓在塑造非资本主义非正式企业再生产中的构成性作用，这些企业维持着被排除在资本主义部分之外的劳动人口，以及部分该人口作为非正式工资劳动力被选择性纳入资本主义部分的过程——这些过程可以通过上述理论框架进行生成性解读。通过这一介入，文章旨在为构建一种去殖民化的当代经济发展过程方法铺平道路。
journal: World Development
title: Development economics and the colonial encounter: Informality, caste, and postcolonial capitalist development in India
title_zh: 发展经济学与殖民遭遇：印度的非正式性、种姓与后殖民资本主义发展

abstract: We show how clustering standard errors in one or more dimensions can be justified in M-estimation when there is sampling or assignment uncertainty. Since existing procedures for variance estimation are either conservative or invalid, we propose a variance estimator that refines a conservative procedure and remains valid. We then interpret environments where clustering is frequently employed in empirical work from our design-based perspective and provide insights on their estimands and inference procedures.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了在M估计中，当存在抽样或分配不确定性时，如何在一个或多个维度上对标准误进行聚类是合理的。鉴于现有的方差估计程序要么保守要么无效，我们提出了一种方差估计器，它改进了保守程序并保持有效性。随后，我们从基于设计的视角解读了实证工作中频繁采用聚类的环境，并对其估计目标及推断程序提供了见解。
journal: Journal of Econometrics
title: Clustering with potential multidimensionality: Inference and practice
title_zh: 多维潜聚类：推断与实践

abstract: A large portion of the developing world has pursued big-push industrialization to promote growth over the past century. This paper utilizes a quasi-experimental design to investigate the long-term impact of such programs. From 1950 to 1959, the Soviet Union sent thousands of experts, engineers, and machinery to China to aid with the first Five-Year Plan of national development and to help establish a network of state-owned industrial plants across China. This massive program was brought to an abrupt standstill following the Sino-Soviet split in the early 1960s. This paper takes the unforeseen termination of the Soviet projects as an exogenous shock and investigates its impact on local economic development in the long run. Counties with more Soviet projects completed by the 1960s are shown to have larger state sectors today and, surprisingly, also enjoy better developmental outcomes overall and in the private sector in particular. Five mechanisms are examined as potential causes. I find no evidence of innovation spillover or differential infrastructure, but strong support for human capital externality and agglomeration through production networks. Resource allocation also continues to favor these localities: even private businesses in counties with more Soviet projects enjoy better access to the financial market.
abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪里，发展中世界的很大一部分地区推行了大推进工业化以促进增长。本文利用准实验设计来考察此类项目的长期影响。1950年至1959年间，苏联派遣了数千名专家、工程师并输送机械设备至中国，协助实施第一个五年国家发展计划，并帮助在中国各地建立国有工业工厂网络。然而，这一大规模项目在20世纪60年代初因中苏分裂而骤然中断。本文将苏联项目的意外终止视为外生冲击，考察其对地方经济的长期影响。研究发现，截至20世纪60年代完成更多苏联项目的县，如今国有部门规模更大，且令人意外的是，这些地区整体发展成果更佳，尤其是私营部门表现更为突出。本文考察了五种可能的机制，未发现创新溢出或基础设施差异的证据，但人力资本外部性和通过生产网络形成的集聚效应得到了有力支持。资源配置也持续偏向这些地区：即便在苏联项目较多的县，私营企业也能获得更好的金融市场准入机会。

abstract: This paper examines how participation in global value chains (GVCs) shapes inflation in the European Union over 1995–2023. Using local projections, we trace the dynamic response of producer- and consumer-price inflation to total, backward, and forward GVC shocks across core, peripheral, and CEEC economies. The aggregate response at the producer-price level is disinflationary and concentrated in the backward channel, supporting the discipline-on-prices hypothesis. A marked PPI–HICP wedge emerges in peripheral economies, where producer-level gains do not reach consumers, while forward linkages feed demand-pull pressures on consumer prices in both core and CEEC suppliers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1995年至2023年间参与全球价值链（GVC）如何影响欧盟的通胀。利用局部投影方法，我们追踪了生产者价格和消费者价格通胀对总体、后向及前向GVC冲击的动态响应，覆盖核心经济体、外围经济体及中东欧国家（CEEC）。生产者价格层面的总体响应呈通缩效应，且集中于后向渠道，支持了价格纪律假说。在外围经济体中，出现了显著的PPI-HICP缺口，生产者层面的收益未能传导至消费者，而前向联系则在核心经济体和CEEC供应商中均对消费者价格产生需求拉动型压力。
journal: Economics Letters
title: GVC participation and inflation in the European Union
title_zh: 欧盟全球价值链参与度与通货膨胀

abstract: This paper studies the behavior of Katz–Bonacich centrality and key-player intercentrality in linear–quadratic network games when spillovers are strong. Understanding this regime is both theoretically important and empirically relevant in environments where interactions are intense. We show that as spillovers become large, Katz–Bonacich centrality converges (up to scale) to the Perron eigenvector, while intercentrality diverges at the same rate for all nodes and becomes dominated by a common leading component. As a result, first-order proportional differences in intercentrality—normalized by the common divergent scale—vanish near the critical threshold. Rankings based on lower-order differences in intercentrality, or on post-removal activity and welfare levels, need not collapse and may remain stable even arbitrarily close to the boundary.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在溢出效应较强时，线性二次网络博弈中Katz–Bonacich中心性与关键参与者间中心性的行为。理解这一机制在理论上具有重要意义，并且在互动密集的环境中具有实证相关性。我们证明，随着溢出效应增大，Katz–Bonacich中心性（按比例）收敛于Perron特征向量，而间中心性对所有节点以相同速率发散，并受一个共同的领先成分主导。因此，在临界阈值附近，以共同发散尺度归一化后的间中心性的一阶比例差异消失。基于间中心性低阶差异或基于移除后活动与福利水平的排序，则不必崩溃，并且即使在边界任意接近的情况下也可能保持稳定。
journal: Economics Letters
title: How to determine key players when spillovers are large
title_zh: 溢出效应显著时如何识别关键参与者

abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, population growth coupled with weak or missing markets for clean energy means that the absolute number of people relying on woodfuels for cooking is growing. Charcoal, which has distinctly different environmental and economic implications from firewood, has become one of the most consumed fuels in the region. However, among rural populations, the drivers and consequences of charcoal use remain under-studied. We examine rural woodfuel dynamics in Malawi, a majority rural country with high poverty, rapid population growth, lagging economic development, and abundant but rapidly declining forest resources. We examine how household energy transitions are influenced by concurrent demographic, economic, and land use changes. Using four waves of national household surveys and satellite-derived forest cover datasets, we investigate trends in household energy consumption, identify factors driving rural household fuel choices, and characterize geographic patterns of forest cover loss during 2004–2020. During this time, the share of rural households using charcoal grew from 3.9% to 13.4%. Rural households that are smaller, headed by younger individuals, and are asset-rich but land-poor had greater odds of using charcoal compared to firewood, indicating that rural livelihood dynamics have important consequences for household energy transitions. Several protected areas have experienced > 20% forest cover loss since 2001, characterized by geographic patterns consistent with unsanctioned woodfuel extraction. These findings emphasize a renewed need for integrated natural resources, energy, and livelihoods management strategies. Our insights provide information for policy makers to better predict and understand the continued growth of charcoal’s popularity in Malawi and similar contexts.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，人口增长与清洁能源市场的薄弱或缺失并存，导致依赖木燃料做饭的绝对人口数量持续增加。木炭，因其与薪柴在环境和经济影响上存在显著差异，已成为该地区消费量最大的燃料之一。然而，在农村人口中，木炭使用的驱动因素及其后果研究仍显不足。我们以马拉维为研究对象，这是一个以农村人口为主的国家，面临高贫困率、快速人口增长、经济发展滞后以及森林资源丰富但迅速减少的挑战。我们探讨了家庭能源转型如何受到人口、经济和土地利用变化同步影响。利用四轮全国性家庭调查数据和卫星获取的森林覆盖数据集，我们分析了2004年至2020年间家庭能源消费的趋势，识别了影响农村家庭燃料选择的因素，并刻画了森林覆盖损失的地理格局。在此期间，使用木炭的农村家庭比例从3.9%上升至13.4%。相较于薪柴，规模较小、户主较年轻、资产丰富但土地匮乏的农村家庭更倾向于使用木炭，这表明农村生计动态对家庭能源转型具有重要影响。自2001年以来，多个保护区经历了超过20%的森林覆盖损失，其地理格局与未经许可的木燃料开采特征相符。这些发现强调了对自然资源、能源和生计管理进行综合策略的迫切需求。我们的研究为政策制定者提供了信息，以更好地预测和理解马拉维及类似背景下木炭普及度持续增长的趋势。
journal: World Development
title: Do coupled population, economic, and land use dynamics explain household energy transitions in Malawi?
title_zh: 马拉维家庭能源转型是否可由人口、经济与土地利用的耦合动态解释？

abstract: The traditional deadweight-loss (DWL) formula rests on a usually unstated, strong assumption: that all other markets are undistorted. We extend the partial-equilibrium DWL formula to cases where the surplus in other markets is non-zero. It involves an additional term of the same order of magnitude as the DWL; this term does not go to zero even when the directly affected market is small relative to the rest of the economy. In examples, we show that the DWL may get the sign of the surplus change wrong when a substantial share of the economy is monopolized or subject to commodity taxes.
abstract_zh: 传统的无谓损失（DWL）公式基于一个通常未明说的强假设：所有其他市场均无扭曲。我们将局部均衡的DWL公式扩展到其他市场剩余非零的情形。该扩展涉及一个与DWL同数量级的额外项；即使直接受影响的市场相对于经济整体规模很小，这一项也不会趋于零。通过实例，我们表明当经济中相当大比例被垄断或受商品税影响时，DWL可能错误地判断剩余变化的符号。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: A new partial-equilibrium approach to approximating the welfare effects of market power and taxes
title_zh: 市场势力与税收福利效应近似的一种新局部均衡方法

abstract: We study a (rent-seeking) contest in which some players form syndicates and compete collectively, while others compete individually, to win a prize (or rent). A syndicate competes, as a single entity, with the other contestants to win the prize. The organizer of a syndicate chooses the syndicate’s effort level. The members of a syndicate share both the cost of effort and the prize (if it wins), according to the syndicate’s sharing rule. We first examine the profitability of being a syndicate member, assuming that the sizes of the syndicates are exogenously given. Then we consider the endogenous formation of syndicates and its effect on prize (or rent) dissipation. We show that, for any given number of players, there is a unique equilibrium size for the syndicate when only one syndicate is formed, and unique equilibrium sizes of the syndicates when two syndicates are formed. We also show that the endogenous formation of syndicates is beneficial both to the syndicate members and to the singletons, and the endogenous formation of syndicates reduces prize dissipation, compared with the individual (rent-seeking) contest.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一种（寻租）竞赛，其中部分参与者组成辛迪加并集体竞争，而其他参与者则单独竞争，以赢得奖品（或租金）。一个辛迪加作为一个整体与其他参赛者竞争以赢得奖品。辛迪加的组织者选择该辛迪加的努力水平。辛迪加成员根据其分配规则，共同分担努力成本和奖品（若获胜）。我们首先考察成为辛迪加成员的盈利性，假设辛迪加的规模是外生给定的。随后，我们考虑辛迪加的内生形成及其对奖品（或租金）耗散的影响。我们证明，对于任意给定的参与者数量，当仅形成一个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模；当形成两个辛迪加时，存在唯一的均衡规模。我们还表明，辛迪加的内生形成对辛迪加成员和独立参与者均有益，并且与个人（寻租）竞赛相比，辛迪加的内生形成减少了奖品耗散。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Endogenous syndicate formation in (rent-seeking) contests
title_zh: （寻租）竞赛中的内生辛迪加形成

abstract: The share of young Australians reporting poor mental health has risen sharply over the past two decades, a pattern mirrored across many high-income countries. A central question is whether this reflects a genuine deterioration in underlying mental health or shifts in how different birth cohorts report their symptoms. Using 22 years of nationally representative longitudinal survey data from Australia (2002–2023), we construct a predicted mental health index from respondents’ socioeconomic characteristics, childhood conditions, physical health, life events, and financial circumstances, and compare it against self-reported mental health to isolate cohort-specific reporting differences. We find that the answer is both, namely, that younger cohorts apply lower thresholds when reporting distress, reflecting greater willingness to acknowledge poor mental health, and underlying mental health has genuinely deteriorated among recent cohorts, particularly females. Adjusting for cohort-specific reporting thresholds flattens the apparent rise in poor mental health, though a deterioration remains. After adjustment, the age gradient steepens, revealing that poor mental health peaks in mid-life, a life-cycle pattern that is obscured in raw self-reports. Our findings underscore the importance of accounting for reporting heterogeneity when interpreting mental health trends and planning health services.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年间，澳大利亚年轻人中报告心理健康状况不佳的比例急剧上升，这一现象在许多高收入国家同样存在。核心问题在于，这是否反映了潜在心理健康的真实恶化，抑或是不同出生队列在报告其症状方式上的差异。利用澳大利亚2002年至2023年间22年的全国代表性纵向调查数据，我们根据受访者的社会经济特征、童年条件、身体健康、生活事件及财务状况构建了一个预测心理健康指数，并将其与自我报告的心理健康状况进行比较，以分离出特定队列的报告差异。我们发现答案两者兼有，即较年轻的队列在报告心理困扰时采用了较低阈值，反映出他们更愿意承认心理健康不佳，同时近期队列（尤其是女性）的潜在心理健康确实出现了恶化。调整队列特定报告阈值后，心理健康不佳的表观上升趋势有所平缓，但恶化现象依然存在。调整后，年龄梯度变得更加陡峭，揭示出心理健康不佳在中年达到顶峰，这一生命周期模式在原始自我报告中并不明显。我们的研究结果强调了在解读心理健康趋势及规划卫生服务时，考虑报告异质性的重要性。
journal: Journal of Population Economics
title: The good old days? Mental health across birth cohorts
title_zh: 美好的旧时光？不同出生队列的心理健康

abstract: Geopolitical tensions have reshaped international trade and investment flows in recent years. This column uses data on the worldwide affiliates of European multinationals over 2010-2020 to study how these firms are restructuring their foreign networks. Foreign network restructuring has transitioned from expansion to contraction over this period, with an increasing share of episodes involving nearshoring, friendshoring, or both. Crucially, network contractions are not associated with higher home-country activity, contrary to expectations. By contrast, network expansions are shown to boost parent activity and domestic networks.
abstract_zh: 近年来，地缘政治紧张局势重塑了国际贸易与投资流动。本文利用2010至2020年间欧洲跨国公司全球分支机构的数据，研究这些企业如何重构其海外网络。在此期间，海外网络重构已从扩张转向收缩，涉及近岸外包、友岸外包或两者兼有的案例占比日益增加。关键在于，与预期相反，网络收缩并未与母国活动的增加相关联。相比之下，网络扩张则被证明能促进母公司活动及国内网络的发展。
journal: VoxEU / CEPR Columns
title: Multinational restructuring, friendshoring, and home country activity
title_zh: 跨国重组、友岸外包与母国经济活动

abstract: The White House Faith Office is expanding federal support for religious organisations. Can government policy change how religious citizens are, and what does blurring the line between church and state do to attitudes and polarisation? Exploiting the staggered rollout of ‘faith-based initiatives’ across US states from 1996 to 2009, this column shows that church attendance rose sharply among Protestants, new faith-based organisations multiplied, and social views hardened against abortion and homosexuality, while the rest of the population continued to secularise.
abstract_zh: 白宫信仰办公室正在扩大对宗教组织的联邦支持。政府政策能否改变宗教公民的信仰状态，而模糊教会与国家界限又会对态度和极化产生何种影响？利用1996年至2009年间美国各州“信仰倡议”分阶段推行的自然实验，本专栏显示，新教徒的教堂出席率显著上升，新兴信仰组织数量倍增，社会观念在堕胎和同性恋问题上趋于强硬，而其余人口则继续世俗化。
authors: Jeanet Bentzen, Alessandro Pizzigolotto, Lena Sperling
journal: VoxEU / CEPR Columns
title: Government support of religion strengthened religiosity and divided America
title_zh: 政府对宗教的支持强化了宗教虔诚并加剧了美国社会分裂

abstract: Despite rapid expansion of farmland transfer in rural China, the quality of contractual governance often fails to keep pace, raising the question of whether spatial consolidation arrangements can promote more complete contract terms. This study examines how coordinated land transfer promotes the standardization of farmland rental contracts within China’s three-rights separation framework. Drawing on primary household survey data from 1101 farming households across four counties in Guizhou Province, this study documents a robust positive relationship between the degree of spatial contiguity in transfer arrangements and the level of contract standardization. Mediation analysis applying the KHB decomposition method reveals that this effect is transmitted primarily through two operational channels: economies of scale and technology adaptation through mechanization adoption. Heterogeneity analysis further reveals that the standardization effect concentrates among operators with greater financial capacity, in regions with stronger market connectivity and irrigation infrastructure, and in villages where collective governance is comparatively weak.
abstract_zh: 尽管中国农村土地流转规模迅速扩张，契约治理质量却往往未能同步提升，由此引发一个问题：空间整合安排能否促进更完整的契约条款？本研究考察在“三权分置”框架下，协调性土地流转如何推动农地租赁契约的标准化。基于贵州省四个县1101户农户的入户调查数据，研究发现流转安排的空间连片程度与契约标准化水平之间存在稳健的正向关系。采用KHB分解法的中介分析表明，这一效应主要通过两条运行渠道传导：规模经济与机械化采纳所引致的技术适应。异质性分析进一步揭示，标准化效应集中于资金能力较强的经营主体、市场连通性和灌溉基础设施较好的地区，以及集体治理相对薄弱的村庄。

abstract: This paper examines how participants from representative surveys in Germany and the United States (N = 2,685) prefer to redistribute a consumer food dollar across supply chain actors, including farmers, how willing they are to support and pay for redistribution, and which attitudes drive each of these preferences. We find widespread support for increasing farmers’ share of food expenditures, primarily driven by the belief that farmers lose from trade and lack alternative trading partners. In contrast, support and willingness to pay for specific interventions are rather shaped by ideological beliefs about markets. These findings demonstrate that folk economic beliefs, such as zero–sum thinking, play a central role in shaping food dollar redistribution. Building on this insight, we develop policy recommendations to help policymakers navigate what we term the Food Dollar Trap: the tension between calls to improve farmers’ incomes and concerns about food affordability.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了来自德国和美国的代表性调查参与者（N = 2,685）如何倾向于在供应链参与者（包括农民）之间重新分配消费者食品支出中的每一美元，他们支持并愿意为这种再分配支付的程度，以及哪些态度驱动了这些偏好。我们发现，广泛支持提高农民在食品支出中的份额，这主要源于一种信念，即农民在贸易中受损且缺乏替代贸易伙伴。相比之下，对具体干预措施的支持和支付意愿则更多地受到关于市场的意识形态信念的影响。这些发现表明，民间经济信念，如零和思维，在塑造食品美元再分配中发挥着核心作用。基于这一见解，我们提出了政策建议，以帮助政策制定者应对我们称之为“食品美元陷阱”的困境：即改善农民收入呼声与对食品可负担性担忧之间的张力。
journal: Food Policy
title: The food dollar trap: attitudes driving public support for redistribution
title_zh: 食品美元陷阱：态度如何驱动公众对再分配的支持

abstract: Hidden fees can distort consumer decision-making. In response, regulators historically have (a) improved disclosure to make fees more salient or (b) standardized products to restrict what fees can be charged. We use Chilean administrative data and a multi-stage natural experiment to separately identify the effects of disclosure and standardization on repayment. We find that disclosure reduces delinquencies by 13.7 percentage points (40%) and default by 1.68 percentage points (98%), whereas standardization has no effect. We find no effect on initial loan terms, suggesting that disclosure’s effects are specific to repayment behavior: specifically, disclosure improves borrowers’ understanding of their credit obligations.
abstract_zh: 隐藏费用可能扭曲消费者的决策。为此，监管机构历来采取两种措施：（a）改进信息披露，使费用更加显眼；或（b）标准化产品，限制可收取的费用类型。我们利用智利的行政数据及一个多阶段自然实验，分别识别信息披露与标准化对还款行为的影响。研究发现，信息披露能将逾期率降低13.7个百分点（降幅40%），并将违约率降低1.68个百分点（降幅98%），而标准化则无显著效果。我们未发现对初始贷款条款的影响，这表明信息披露的效果特定于还款行为：具体而言，信息披露增强了借款人对自身信贷义务的理解。
journal: Journal of Financial Economics
title: Removing the fine print: Disclosure, standardized products, and consumer outcomes
title_zh: 去除细则：信息披露、标准化产品与消费者结果
